Renders a complete shadcn/ui form automatically from an existing Zod or Yup schema.

Source: [autoform](https://github.com/vantezzen/autoform) by vantezzen — MIT.

Ships as an npm library rather than copy-paste source.

```bash
npm install @autoform/react @autoform/shadcn
```
